posts.title: Capturing the Mouse for a First-Person Controller
posts.description: A first-person game needs a slightly different approach to mouse input than a typical desktop application. Normally, the mouse cursor moves around the screen. In a first-person game, however, we don't really care about the cursor's position. We care about how much the mouse moved .
